title: ops.digest.daily@1 (DEC-0153): one closed UTC day of a product's hourly operations digests (one line for each hour it observed itself running in), folded
description: One line of daily-YYYY-MM.jsonl. Counts only: no log line, no path, no identifier, no free text. FAC-SEM-166: day a real UTC day, each op once in ops and at most once in risen, total each counter's sum over ops, every rise an op of ops in at most the day's hours with at least 10 failures an hour it rose and no more than the day's failures. FAC-SEM-167: no op shaped like a credential or holding a home folder.

hours.description: How many hourly digests of the day were folded (hours folded, never uptime: OD-1).

ops.description: Every operation of the day's hours, summed, once each.

hours.description: The hours of the day op rose in.

failed.description: The failures of op in the hours it rose in.

risen.description: Each operation that rose in some hour of the day (OD-4), the most failures first.
